Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

CovariateSearcher 0.5.0

This release comes from a full review of the package. Searches are more reliable, validation is stricter, and some outputs change. Read “Changes you may notice” before rerunning an existing project.

Changes you may notice

  • Categorical covariate THETAs are named by the numeric level (beta_SEX_CL_2), whether or not a lookup file is given. Reports decode the level (“Effect of SEX (Female) on CL”). Models named by the decoded label in older versions (beta_SEX_CL_FEMALE) are still read. The lookup_file argument of model_add_cov() and add_covariate_to_model() no longer changes the model.
  • Validation at initialisation stops on:
    • a THETA initial value of 0 that is not FIXED, in the base model or in INIT;
    • END IF in $PK (NM-TRAN only accepts ENDIF);
    • a log-normal parameter written P = EXP(... + ETA) whose typical value does not come through TV_<param> (TV_P = THETA(n), MU_k = LOG(TV_P));
    • a bounded THETA written across two lines;
    • categorical LEVELS that differ from the levels in the data, a categorical covariate with fewer than two levels, or with no REFERENCE;
    • a continuous formula that uses the reference but has no REFERENCE;
    • a STATUS other than con/cat, a FORMULA that is neither built-in nor an expression in cov, or a non-numeric REFERENCE;
    • require_cov_step that is not TRUE/FALSE, or a non-numeric rse_threshold.
  • build_covariate_reference_table() stops when a covariate has no value at TIME == 0.
  • A missing record (NA or .) is not a covariate value: it no longer makes a covariate time-varying and no longer becomes a categorical level. The dataset is read with . as missing.
  • A run counts as finished only when its listing has Stop Time:. An NM-TRAN error counts as failed at once, even if result files from an earlier run are present.
  • Parameter tables show estimates with 3 significant figures (OFV 2 decimals, condition number 1). The condition number is NONMEM’s (from the correlation matrix), labelled “Condition number”. model_report() states the CV% formula in a footer.
  • The search database’s phase column holds base, forward_selection, redemption, backward_elimination or manual; action holds what was done (add_covariate, remove_covariate, retry, …). Older databases are still read.

New

  • retest_failed in run_automated_scm_testing() and continue_search() (default TRUE): whether covariates excluded after a failed model and a failed retry are tested again.
  • id_col in create_covariate_boxplots(): n = counts distinct subjects.
  • load_tags() takes the path of the tags file.

Search fixes

  • Selective forward: redemption starts from the best model with every covariate not yet tested on it, is numbered after the last step created, and continues for as long as each step finds something significant. It no longer re-runs the last step’s models or stops after one round.
  • Excluding a covariate after a failed retry takes effect.
  • The final backward runs after a forward search that changed nothing, when the starting model already has covariates and no initial backward ran.
  • A covariate fixed in INIT is never removed in backward elimination, and degrees of freedom are read from the right row when a covariate is on several parameters.
  • An error in the initial backward phase stops the search instead of continuing on a stale model counter. New model numbers never reuse a run<N> on disk.
  • Removing a covariate stops if its THETA is still used elsewhere in $PK.
  • $THETA blocks spread over several records, values on the record line, several values on one line, comment lines and $THETAP/$THETAPV priors are numbered correctly everywhere.
  • A covariate is placed on the right scale when an IOV term or a scaled ETA shares the EXP(), and after a time-varying covariate was added to a log-scale parameter.

Resume (continue_search())

  • A model the search created but never started is submitted (auto_submit = TRUE) or reported in incomplete_step; it is no longer counted as failed.
  • Retry models on disk are registered, and a failed model without a retry gets one (auto_retry = TRUE).
  • A selective search always re-enters selective forward, so redemption starts or continues after a resume.
  • Checkpoints are written when a step’s models are created and when the step is done; nothing is saved while waiting.

Reports and plots

  • The results summary names the removal the search made and takes the final model from the last step that changed it.
  • Bootstrap intervals: the CI column is a column named with “CI” as a word, or a lower/upper pair; round-bracket intervals parse.
  • Without spec_pk, parameter tables are still grouped into sections.
  • Forest plots: fractional percentiles are labelled as written (2.5th); a single-line IF with nested parentheses is evaluated, and an IF condition that cannot be evaluated triggers a warning. Exposure tables include only the metrics that have a label.
  • Boxplots: tied quantiles are labelled by interval, and the jittered points are reproducible.
  • Control streams saved in Windows-1252 are read correctly and keep their encoding when the package writes them back.
